Can't drink another drop... Mmm... I'll burst if I keep this up.
Why does he drink so much when he can't handle it...?
strings.야, 집에 가. 제발 좀 가라. 장사도 안 되는데…. 가, 좀. 안 가면: Hey, go home. Please, just go. Business is bad enough already... Go on. Or do I have to throw you out?
strings.스텔란 아저씨. 흠냐…. 아저씨 말씀대로 했어요. 흠냐…. 이제 니다로스: Mr. Stellan... Mmm... I did what you said... Mmm... Nidaros and Embla will be all right now...
strings.아스크렌, 내가 모르는 것 같지?: Askren, you think I don't know, don't you?
I'll wait. Tell me properly when you're ready...
strings.야, 박자 틀렸잖아! 그냥 맞춰서 외치기만 하면 되는데, 왜 그걸 틀려?: Hey, you're off the beat! All you have to do is count in time. How are you getting that wrong?
strings.엇박자잖아. 내 동생 박치였나?: You're still off the beat. Has my little brother always had no sense of rhythm?
Oh, come on, Carmen. Why make me do this? I don't even dance.
strings.미안하다며? 말 잘 듣겠다며?: Didn't you say you were sorry? And that you'd do as I asked?
strings.알았어. 그럼 다른 거 할게. 정말 다른 거 한다?: Fine. I'll try something else, then. Ready? I'm doing a different one.
One, two, three, tombé, pas de bourrée.
strings.(카르멘이 라스의 구령에 따라 열심히 동작을 연습한다.): (Carmen practices her steps diligently to Lars' count.)
strings.하나, 둘, 셋, 글리사드 아삼블레…. 쉬고 하나, 둘, 셋, 돔베 파드: One, two, three, glissade, assemblé... Pause, then one, two, three, tombé, pas de bourrée...
You're good, Carmen. Better than before.
If you didn't hear me, forget it.
strings.이 귀로 똑똑히 들었지. '누나, 잘 하네. 전보다 많이 좋아져서 너무: Oh, I heard you perfectly! You said, 'Carmen, you're so good! You've improved so much, you're amazing!'
strings.그렇게까진 말 안 했어! 안 했다고!: I didn't say all that! I didn't!
strings.후후, 착한 녀석. 아, 기분이다. 플라타 무용단 오디션 붙어서 메인 댄: Hehe, you're a sweet kid. You know what? When I pass the Plata Dance Company's audition and perform as their lead dancer, I'll get you a good seat.
strings.어? 여태까지 가족들 초대 안 하려고 했던 거야?: Huh? Were you planning not to invite your family until now?
Lars! I'm touched. You just assumed your big sister would pass!
Oh, enough. Get on with it.
One, two, three, glissade, assemblé... One, two, three, tombé, pas de bourrée.
strings.그 다음은 또 뭐야? 빨리 말해. 말 안하면 나 집에 들어간다?: What's next? Hurry up and tell me. If you don't, I'm going home!
